sn55.9:1.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.9:1.4: asokā nāma bhante, bhikkhunī kālakatā tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
sn55.9:1.5: asoko nāma bhante, upāsako kālakato tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
sn55.9:1.7: tassā kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo? ti.
sn55.9:2.1: asoko ānanda, bhikkhu kālakato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi …pe…
sn55.9:3.1: ayaṃ kho so ānanda, dhammādāso. dhammapariyāyo
sn55.9:3.2: yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ vyākareyya:
sn55.9:3.3: “khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi, avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti”.
